messages:
maya: Heads up — onboarding dashboard is showing ~120 accounts with no owner mapped, which means the auto-playbook never fired. Noticed a cluster in Mid-Market/EU. Could be why renewal risk signals spiked this morning.

alejandro: Oof. Is this the missing 'owner_id' -> AE mapping bug we saw last month? I can run a targeted backfill if we confirm the logic.

maya: Looks like the mapping broke for accounts created between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-06 (devops-provision change). We'll need a backfill + a small mapping fix. Also want to recalibrate the healthscore so those accounts don't stay 'unknown' until next manual touch.

sb-analytics-bot: alert: cohort "MM_EU_onboarded_2025-11" healthscore drop > 35% compared to baseline. sample_count=128 affected=118

jess: Agree we should be careful with a blind update. Can we run the backfill in staging first and validate a sample? Also what's the playbook trigger condition — owner != null AND onboarding_status = 'in_progress' ?

alejandro: Yes playbook trigger is owner_id IS NOT NULL AND onboarding_status = 'in_progress' AND playbook_disabled != true

operations: Please don't run a prod update during EMEA business hours. Can we schedule the staging run now, and prod during next maintenance window (UTC 0200)?

samir: I'll take the staging validation. Plan: (1) run backfill query in staging for the affected date range, (2) run healthscore recompute for a sample of 50 accounts, (3) verify playbook fires. If all good, ops can schedule prod run.

maya: Thanks Samir. Alejandro — can you share the exact update SQL and the healthscore recompute command so ops can review before approving? Put steps here so we have an audit trail.

alejandro: SQL snippet — run in a transaction in staging first:

```
BEGIN;
UPDATE accounts a
SET owner_id = COALESCE(a.owner_id, (
  SELECT ae.user_id FROM account_assignments aa
  JOIN account_teams at ON aa.team_id = at.id
  JOIN users ae ON aa.user_id = ae.id
  WHERE aa.account_id = a.id AND at.role = 'AE'
  ORDER BY aa.assigned_at DESC LIMIT 1
))
WHERE a.created_at >= '2025-11-01' AND a.created_at < '2025-11-07' AND a.owner_id IS NULL;
-- verify
SELECT id, owner_id FROM accounts WHERE created_at >= '2025-11-01' AND created_at < '2025-11-07' AND owner_id IS NULL LIMIT 50;
ROLLBACK; -- for staging
```

Healthscore recompute (CLI):

```
cs-tool recompute-healthscore --account-ids $(cat sample_accounts.txt) --force --env staging
```

alejandro: For prod we switch ROLLBACK to COMMIT and run during ops window.

jess: Slight tweak request: add a small safeguard to skip accounts with flag playbook_disabled = true and to add a note to account history when owner set by backfill (so CSMs aren't surprised).

alejandro: Good call. Will add update to write audit_note and skip playbook_disabled.

operations: Security check — ensure the DB user running this has only the necessary permissions and we capture a SQL dump of affected rows to S3 for rollback.

samir: I'll create a sample_accounts.txt from the staging query and run recompute. I'll post the before/after healthscore deltas here.

liz: Once validated, please also add a short rule to the onboarding playbook: if owner is still null after backfill, set owner to 'unassigned-ae-rotation' and queue AE assignment. That way auto-playbook still triggers and we don't have blind 'unknown' health.

maya: TL;DR proposed action items:
1) Alejandro: prepare final SQL with safeguards + audit note (due EOD)
2) Samir: run staging backfill + health recompute and paste results (start now)
3) Ops: schedule prod slot UTC 0200 and prep S3 snapshot + runbook
4) Liz & Jess: update playbook rule to handle fallback owner and skip flag handling
5) Maya: create JIRA ticket CSM-7881 for tracking communications and outbound pings to affected accounts

alejandro: Working on SQL now, will push to the #cs-ops-runbook gist once ready.

sb-analytics-bot: note: will queue a recompute job after prod backfill to refresh dashboards. ETA +1h post-deploy.

maya: Thanks team. Samir — ping here when staging sample done and drop the diffs. I'll draft a short outreach template for AEs to use if healthscore drops post-fix.

samir: Staging run in progress, posting results in ~25m.

jess: :thumbsup:
